sources.title: GitHub - sthanika-ai/sieve: Decision models that return calibrated ...
sources.snippet: Sieve is a family of decision models. Give a model a piece of text or JSON (the state) and typed questions, and it returns a calibrated probability for every option of every question. It reads the state once, scores the options directly, and never generates text. Each model is a LoRA adapter and a small pointer head on an open Qwen backbone.
